text.tspan: Shared responsibility model, applied to IAM
AWS is responsible for (security OF the cloud)
• the IAM service itself running and secure
YOU are responsible for (security IN the cloud)
• users, groups, roles, policies: create, manage, monitor
• enable and enforce MFA on all accounts
• use IAM tools to apply the right permissions
• analyse access patterns and review permissions
If your access key leaks on GitHub, or a user has AdministratorAccess they don't need, that is YOUR fault, not AWS's.
Exam phrase: "who is responsible for managing IAM users and MFA?" → the customer.
